subject: Languages
description: Languages complete progression map — 6 year levels, 116 standards, 8 strands. Merged from 4 source files.

standards.title: Recognise and communicate meaning
standards.description: with support, recognise and communicate meaning in the target language
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise and communicate meaning in the target language with support.

standards.title: Explore language features
standards.description: explore, with support, language features of the target language noticing similarities and differences between the target language and English
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore language features of the target language, noticing similarities and differences with English.

standards.title: Explore language and culture connections
standards.description: explore connections between language and culture
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore connections between language and culture.

standards.title: Recognise and communicate meaning
standards.description: with support, recognise and communicate meaning in the target language
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise and communicate meaning in the target language with support.

standards.title: Explore language features
standards.description: explore, with support, language features of the target language noticing similarities and differences between the target language and English

standards.title: Explore language and culture connections
standards.description: explore connections between language and culture
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students explore connections between language and culture.

standards.title: Recognise and respond to classroom language

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise and respond to modelled classroom greetings, instructions, routines and personal introductions.

standards.title: Participate in guided language activities

standards.title: Language carries cultural meaning

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students notice that language carries cultural meaning in classroom greetings, introductions and routines.

standards.title: Create texts using familiar language

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students use words, familiar phrases and modelled language to create spoken, written and multimodal texts.

standards.title: Sounds and rhythms of the target language
standards.description: recognise and imitate the sounds and rhythms of the target language
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise and imitate the sounds and rhythms of the target language.

standards.title: Roman alphabet and language features

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise how the Roman alphabet and language features construct meaning in the target language.

standards.title: Target language and English similarities
standards.description: notice that the target language has features that may be similar to or different from English
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students notice similarities and differences between the target language and English language features.

standards.title: Language reflects cultural practices
standards.description: notice that people use language in ways that reflect cultural practices
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students notice that people use language in ways that reflect cultural practices.

standards.title: Interact in classroom routines and introductions
standards.description: interact in classroom-related routines and personal introductions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students interact in classroom-related routines and personal introductions.

standards.title: Collaborate in play-based activities
standards.description: collaborate with others in a range of play-based activities using modelled expressions and visual and spoken cues
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students collaborate with others in play-based activities using modelled expressions and cues.

standards.title: Locate key information in texts

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students locate key information in spoken and written texts and respond using gestures, images, words and modelled sentences.

standards.title: Recognise cultural meaning in interaction

standards.title: Create texts with familiar language

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students create spoken, written and multimodal texts using familiar words, modelled phrases and sentences, copying known characters and Pinyin.

standards.title: Recognise sound patterns and tones
standards.description: recognise and use sound patterns and tones of the target language
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise and use sound patterns and tones of the target language.

standards.title: Recognise meaning-making features
standards.description: recognise that target language components and/or characters and features of language are used to construct meaning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise that components, characters and features of language are used to construct meaning.

standards.title: Recognise similarities and differences with English
standards.description: recognise that the target language has features that may be similar to or different from English
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise that the target language has features that may be similar to or different from English.

standards.title: Notice language reflects cultural practices
standards.description: notice that people use language in ways that reflect cultural practices
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students notice that people use language in ways that reflect cultural practices.

standards.title: Initiate and respond to questions
standards.description: initiate exchanges and respond to modelled questions about self, others, and classroom environment, using formulaic expressions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students initiate exchanges and respond to modelled questions about self, others and classroom using formulaic expressions.

standards.title: Plan with others using familiar phrases
standards.description: participate in activities that involve planning with others, using a range of familiar phrases and modelled structures
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students participate in activities involving planning with others using familiar phrases and modelled structures.

standards.title: Locate and respond to key information
standards.description: locate and respond to key information related to familiar content obtained from spoken, written and multimodal texts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students locate and respond to key information in spoken, written and multimodal texts on familiar content.

standards.title: Comprehend and convey cultural meaning
standards.description: develop strategies to comprehend and adjust the target language in familiar contexts to convey cultural meaning
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students develop strategies to comprehend and adjust language in familiar contexts to convey cultural meaning.

standards.title: Create informative and imaginative texts
standards.description: create and present informative and imaginative spoken, written and multimodal texts using formulaic expressions, simple phrases and sentences and modelled textual conventions
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students create and present informative and imaginative texts using formulaic expressions and modelled conventions.

standards.title: Sounds, pronunciation and intonation

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise and use modelled sounds, pronunciation and intonation patterns to form words and phrases.

standards.title: Grammar and syntax in familiar texts
standards.description: recognise target language conventions, grammatical structures and basic syntax in familiar texts and contexts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise target language conventions, grammatical structures and basic syntax in familiar texts.

standards.title: Compare target language and English features

standards.title: Language and cultural practices
standards.description: identify connections between target language and cultural practices

standards.title: Initiate and respond in familiar contexts

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students initiate exchanges and respond to questions about home and classroom environments using familiar expressions.

standards.title: Plan and transact with others

standards.title: Locate, organise and respond to information

standards.title: Interpret language conveying cultural meaning

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students develop strategies to interpret language that conveys cultural meaning.

standards.title: Create spoken, written and multimodal texts

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students create and present informative and imaginative spoken, written and multimodal texts using sentence structures, conventions, characters and/or Pinyin appropriate to context.

standards.title: Recognise and use tonal features
standards.description: recognise and use the tonal features of the target language in different contexts and understand how syllables are represented
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise and use tonal features in different contexts and understand how syllables are represented.

standards.title: Recognise writing system and syntax features
standards.description: recognise and use features of the target language writing system, familiar components and/or characters, a range of sentence structures and basic syntax, in familiar texts and contexts
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise and use features of the writing system, familiar components or characters, sentence structures and syntax in familiar texts and contexts.

standards.title: Recognise and compare spoken and written features

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students recognise and compare features of familiar spoken and written text in the target language and English.

standards.title: Identify language and cultural connections
standards.description: identify connections between target language and cultural practices
standards.progression_checkpoint: Students identify connections between target language and cultural practices.

standards.title: Initiate and sustain exchanges

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students initiate and sustain modelled exchanges in familiar contexts related to personal worlds and school.

standards.title: Process and respond to information

standards.progression_checkpoint: Students apply strategies to interpret and convey meaning in familiar cultural contexts.

standards.title: Language reflects culture and identity

standards.title: Initiate and sustain exchanges

standards.title: Compare structures using metalanguage
